description: Free local advisory (no GLM call): given a task profile, returns GLM-vs-Opus, model, confidence, and reasons. Call when unsure which engine to use.

chinese.description: True if Chinese or Chinese-English bilingual (GLM strength, +1).

input_tokens.description: Approx context size needed. >128K forces Opus (GLM degrades past ~100K).

latency_sensitive.description: True if a tight interactive loop (forces Opus).

long_horizon.description: True if many sequential steps / multi-hour autonomy.

needs_parallel.description: True if it needs several concurrent agents (forces Opus).

steps.description: Approx number of dependent sequential steps. >20 forces Opus (goal drift).

tool_pattern.description: Tool-use shape: single one-shot call / short independent fanout (GLM-ok) vs heavy dependent agentic loop (forces Opus).

unfamiliar_api.description: True if it uses a niche/post-cutoff/internal API GLM can't know (-2; paste docs or use Opus).

vision.description: True if input includes images/screenshots/GUI/computer-use (forces Opus).

name: glm_recommend
title: Recommend GLM vs Opus for a task
